title: Branch Assist | Silent tool walkthrough

scenes.title: Ask your first question
scenes.note: Ask a banking procedure question or choose an example. Search all 11 provided documents, or select one to keep the conversation focused.
scenes.description: Ask a banking procedure question or choose an example. Search all 11 provided documents, or select one to keep the conversation focused.

scenes.title: Ask how much coin can stay overnight
scenes.note: Ask how much coin can stay in a machine overnight. The answer gives a $5,250 limit and links to procedure PR63, so you can check the rule for yourself.
scenes.description: Ask how much coin can stay in a machine overnight. The answer gives a $5,250 limit and links to procedure PR63, so you can check the rule for yourself.

scenes.title: Read the rule behind the answer
scenes.note: Select the source link below the answer to read the exact rule. The original wording and nearby conditions appear beside the conversation, making the answer easy to check.
scenes.description: Select the source link below the answer to read the exact rule. The original wording and nearby conditions appear beside the conversation, making the answer easy to check.

scenes.title: See where the information came from
scenes.note: See which document the answer came from and whether the file matches the copy provided for this exercise. This confirms the source copy; it does not tell us if the policy has changed.
scenes.description: See which document the answer came from and whether the file matches the copy provided for this exercise. This confirms the source copy; it does not tell us if the policy has changed.

scenes.title: See why this passage was chosen
scenes.note: See why this passage was chosen for your question. The scores help rank useful source text. To judge the answer itself, read the linked passage and review the answer checks.
scenes.description: See why this passage was chosen for your question. The scores help rank useful source text. To judge the answer itself, read the linked passage and review the answer checks.

scenes.title: Read the complete procedure
scenes.note: Download the complete procedure when a short excerpt is not enough. You can read the surrounding steps, conditions and exceptions before deciding what to do next.
scenes.description: Download the complete procedure when a short excerpt is not enough. You can read the surrounding steps, conditions and exceptions before deciding what to do next.

scenes.title: See how the answer was checked
scenes.note: Open Checks to see whether the answer links to a source, uses supported numbers and agrees with the quoted text. These checks help flag problems, but a person should still review the guidance.
scenes.description: Open Checks to see whether the answer links to a source, uses supported numbers and agrees with the quoted text. These checks help flag problems, but a person should still review the guidance.

scenes.title: Follow the steps behind the answer
scenes.note: Follow what the tool did: find relevant passages, write a draft and check it before showing the answer. The activity list also shows how long each step took.
scenes.description: Follow what the tool did: find relevant passages, write a draft and check it before showing the answer. The activity list also shows how long each step took.

scenes.title: Save a record of this answer
scenes.note: Save a record of this answer, including your question, the source passages and the checks. This gives a reviewer the information needed to follow how the response was produced.
scenes.description: Save a record of this answer, including your question, the source passages and the checks. This gives a reviewer the information needed to follow how the response was produced.

scenes.title: Ask a related question about monthly testing
scenes.note: Ask whether monthly coin-machine testing needs one person or two. The assistant stays on the same topic and finds the testing rule, which says this task uses one-person control.
scenes.description: Ask whether monthly coin-machine testing needs one person or two. The assistant stays on the same topic and finds the testing rule, which says this task uses one-person control.

scenes.title: Check the source for the follow-up
scenes.note: Check the source for the follow-up too. The assistant links to the monthly-testing instructions, so this answer can be checked against the rule for that specific task.
scenes.description: Check the source for the follow-up too. The assistant links to the monthly-testing instructions, so this answer can be checked against the rule for that specific task.

scenes.title: Move on to savings-bond fees
scenes.note: Ask a new question about savings-bond fees. The assistant moves to the savings-bond procedure, keeping the answer tied to the new topic.
scenes.description: Ask a new question about savings-bond fees. The assistant moves to the savings-bond procedure, keeping the answer tied to the new topic.

scenes.title: Find the procedure you need
scenes.note: Find the notary procedure by searching the library. Choose Use in workspace to focus your next questions on that document.
scenes.description: Find the notary procedure by searching the library. Choose Use in workspace to focus your next questions on that document.

scenes.title: Keep questions within the selected document
scenes.note: The workspace is set to the notary procedure, but the question is about coin machines. The assistant asks you to change the selected document before continuing.
scenes.description: The workspace is set to the notary procedure, but the question is about coin machines. The assistant asks you to change the selected document before continuing.

scenes.title: Ask about notarizing an emailed document
scenes.note: Ask if an emailed document can be notarized. The provided procedure says no, even if the requester is there in person. Open the source link to read the full rule.
scenes.description: Ask if an emailed document can be notarized. The provided procedure says no, even if the requester is there in person. Open the source link to read the full rule.

scenes.title: Change one detail and ask again
scenes.note: Now ask, "What if the person is here?" The assistant remembers that the document was emailed, so it keeps the same restriction and points you back to the relevant rule.
scenes.description: Now ask, "What if the person is here?" The assistant remembers that the document was emailed, so it keeps the same restriction and points you back to the relevant rule.

scenes.title: Check the savings-bond limit for a newer account
scenes.note: For an account open less than 12 months, the source lists a total savings-bond redemption limit of $1,000 per day. Read the related conditions alongside the amount.
scenes.description: For an account open less than 12 months, the source lists a total savings-bond redemption limit of $1,000 per day. Read the related conditions alongside the amount.

scenes.title: See what happens when an answer fails a check
scenes.note: Ask about The Private Bank Experience exception. After one retry, the draft still fails a check, so the tool holds it back and shows the original source text for you to review.
scenes.description: Ask about The Private Bank Experience exception. After one retry, the draft still fails a check, so the tool holds it back and shows the original source text for you to review.

scenes.chapter: Save your work and start fresh
scenes.title: Flag a response and save your work
scenes.note: Mark the response Needs review and save the conversation. The download includes the questions, answers, source text, checks and your feedback for someone to follow up.
scenes.description: Mark the response Needs review and save the conversation. The download includes the questions, answers, source text, checks and your feedback for someone to follow up.

scenes.chapter: Save your work and start fresh
scenes.title: Start fresh and ask for clarification
scenes.note: Start a new conversation, then ask, "Can they do that?" The assistant asks what situation you mean. Details from the previous conversation are not carried into the new one.
scenes.description: Start a new conversation, then ask, "Can they do that?" The assistant asks what situation you mean. Details from the previous conversation are not carried into the new one.

scenes.chapter: Save your work and start fresh
scenes.title: Try a question the documents cannot answer
scenes.note: Ask about tomorrow's weather. The tool only has the provided banking procedures to work from, so it explains that it cannot answer this question from those documents.
scenes.description: Ask about tomorrow's weather. The tool only has the provided banking procedures to work from, so it explains that it cannot answer this question from those documents.

scenes.chapter: Save your work and start fresh
scenes.title: Ask about a document that is missing
scenes.note: Ask about a procedure that was not provided. The assistant explains that the document is missing, so you know another source is needed before its rules can be checked.
scenes.description: Ask about a procedure that was not provided. The assistant explains that the document is missing, so you know another source is needed before its rules can be checked.

scenes.chapter: Save your work and start fresh
scenes.title: Try asking the tool to ignore its rules
scenes.note: Try asking the assistant to ignore its rules. This example is blocked. It demonstrates one safeguard; more testing is needed to assess security.
scenes.description: Try asking the assistant to ignore its rules. This example is blocked. It demonstrates one safeguard; more testing is needed to assess security.

scenes.title: Review the test results and their limits
scenes.note: Review how often the tool found useful passages and how much of the expected answer it covered. These tests help reveal gaps; they do not replace review by a subject expert.
scenes.description: Review how often the tool found useful passages and how much of the expected answer it covered. These tests help reveal gaps; they do not replace review by a subject expert.

scenes.title: Take the reports and presentation with you
scenes.note: Download the results report, solution overview and presentation. They explain how the tool was built, what was tested and where further review or improvement is needed.
scenes.description: Download the results report, solution overview and presentation. They explain how the tool was built, what was tested and where further review or improvement is needed.
